scene_description: A woman with long hair stands at a large airport window, looking outside. She has a rolling suitcase and a tote bag beside her. Through the window, an airplane is flying in the sky.

questions.question: What is flying in the sky in this picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look up near the top of the picture, outside the window.

questions.question: What is the woman doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the woman's body — which way is she facing and what is she doing?

questions.question: Where is the woman standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big window and the suitcase — what kind of place has those things?

questions.question: What do people use a suitcase for?
sample_answers: to bring stuff on a trip
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the suitcase next to the woman — think about when you see suitcases.

questions.question: What might the woman do next?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at her suitcase and the airplane outside — what do people do at an airport?

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been on an airplane or at an airport?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you traveled somewhere far away.
